internal: Product A revenue fell 27% starting May.
Product A units sold fell 25%; average price rose 3%.
external: [competitor] A competitor launched Product X, a direct substitute, on 5 May.
[price] The company raised Product A's list price on 18 April.
[demand] Industry demand in the category was approximately flat.
research_cases.question: Why did Product A revenue fall?

internal: ROAS fell from 4.1 to 2.9 between Q2 and Q3.
Paid social spend rose 60% while its revenue rose 8%.
external: [cpm] Industry reports show paid social CPMs rose about 35% in Q3.
[tracking] A platform privacy change in July reduced attributed conversions.
research_cases.question: What explains the ROAS decline?

internal: Churn rose from 3.1% to 4.4% per month from March.
Support tickets per customer rose 40% from February.
external: [outage] The company had a two-day service outage on 20 February.
[competitor] A competitor cut prices by 15% in June.
research_cases.question: Why did churn rise?

internal: Average delivery time rose 18% in November.
Shipment volume rose 45% in November.
external: [peak] November is the national peak shopping season; carriers report congestion.
[fuel] Fuel prices were unchanged in November.
research_cases.question: Why did delivery times get worse?

internal: Conversion rate fell from 2.8% to 2.1% after 10 June.
Mobile sessions' conversion fell most (3.0% to 1.9%).
external: [release] A new mobile checkout was released on 9 June.
[holiday] No holidays or promotions ran in June in either year.
research_cases.question: What caused the conversion drop?

internal: Average length of stay fell from 5.2 to 4.6 days in 2024.
Readmissions within 30 days rose from 8% to 10%.
external: [policy] A national early-discharge incentive began in January 2024.
[case_mix] The regional health authority reports an unchanged case mix.
research_cases.question: Did the discharge policy shorten stays and raise readmissions?

internal: Defect rate rose from 1.2% to 2.0% from week 14.
The rise is on line 3 only.
external: [supplier] Line 3 switched resin supplier in week 13.
[humidity] Plant humidity logs show no change.
research_cases.question: What caused the defect rise?

internal: Voluntary attrition rose from 11% to 16% in 2024.
The rise is concentrated in engineering.
external: [market] Engineering salaries in the region rose about 12% in 2024 (survey).
[remote] The company ended remote work for engineering in March 2024.
research_cases.question: Why is engineering attrition up?

internal: Average final scores fell 6 points in 2024.
The fall is similar across all campuses.
external: [curriculum] A new national curriculum started in September 2023.
[exam] The national exam board changed the grading scale for 2024.
research_cases.question: Did the new curriculum cause the score drop?

internal: Card fraud losses rose 30% in Q3.
80% of the new fraud used one payment method.
external: [breach] A card processor disclosed a data breach in July.
[volume] Transaction volume on that method rose 5% in Q3.
research_cases.question: Why did fraud losses rise?

internal: Leads from search fell 22% in April.
Search spend was unchanged.
external: [algo] A search engine announced a ranking update on 2 April.
[season] April search leads in the two prior years were within 3% of March.
research_cases.question: Why did search leads fall?

internal: Region North net sales rose 15% in Q2.
Other regions were flat.
external: [store] A new flagship store opened in North on 1 April.
[weather] Weather in Q2 was typical across regions.
research_cases.question: What drove North's growth?

internal: Satisfaction scores fell from 4.3 to 3.9 in May.
Complaints about delivery doubled in May.
external: [carrier] The company switched delivery carrier on 1 May.
[survey] The survey question wording was unchanged.
research_cases.question: Why did satisfaction fall?

internal: Average order value rose 12% in Q4.
Units per order were unchanged.
external: [inflation] Category prices rose about 11% industry-wide in Q4 (statistics office).
[upsell] No new upsell feature was launched.
research_cases.question: Why did order value rise?

internal: Failed first delivery attempts rose from 6% to 11% in March.
The rise is concentrated in two hubs.
external: [staffing] Those two hubs replaced 40% of riders in February.
[address] Address data quality audits found no change.
research_cases.question: Why did failed attempts rise?

internal: Email revenue fell 30% in June.
Open rates fell from 24% to 15%.
external: [privacy] A mail client began pre-loading images in June, distorting open tracking.
[list] The mailing list size was unchanged.
research_cases.question: Is the email revenue fall real, and why?

internal: Treatment cost per patient rose 9% in 2024.
external: [drug] The price of a common biologic rose 25% in January 2024.
[volume] Admissions were unchanged.
research_cases.question: Why did cost per patient rise?

internal: Energy use per unit rose 14% in winter months.
external: [weather] Winter was 3 degrees colder than average.
[tariff] The energy tariff did not change.
research_cases.question: Why did energy per unit rise?

internal: Online channel share rose from 30% to 42% in 2024.
external: [closures] The company closed 12 stores in January 2024.
[trend] Industry online share rose from 28% to 31% in 2024.
research_cases.question: Why did the online share rise?

internal: Customers acquired through referral churn 40% less than others.
external: [selection] Referred customers are, by industry studies, higher-intent on average.
[programme] No referral-specific retention programme exists.
research_cases.question: Does the referral programme reduce churn?
